description: This file contains helper functions related to employee status and messenger type options within a SuiteCRM/ SugarCRM extension module. It includes functions for generating HTML select elements with options for employee status and messenger types based on the current context and user permissions.

methods.name: getEmployeeStatusOptions
methods.description: Generates an HTML select element or returns an employee status string based on the provided context, user privileges, and configuration settings.

methods.name: getMessengerTypeOptions
methods.description: Generates an HTML select element or returns a messenger type string based on the context.
